translations.web: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
translations.bsb: The city of chaos is shattered; every house is closed to entry.
translations.kjv: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
translations.asv: The waste city is broken down; every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
